zh: 修正香港 MPF 低收入供款、已達成儲蓄目標、月初存款倒推及極端分期 APR 等核心計算邊界錯誤。
修正智能精靈把 3.5% 顯示成 0.04% 的百分比口徑問題，並修正流程進度顯示。
修正深色模式白底淺字導致大量內容幾乎不可讀的問題，首頁、計算頁、智能精靈與設定頁改用 Material 3 語義色。
修正香港按揭 P/H 按欄位誤標、重複文字及 MPF 低收入說明不完整的問題。
強化跨平台 JSON 計算接口，支援來自 JSON 的 int、double、string 與 boolean 表達，不再依賴 Dart 精確型別。
新增正式 Web 構建入口，Android、Web 共用同一套計算引擎與 UI。
新增 App 內版本檢查、啟動後靜默自動檢查及公開更新清單機制，支援 Android 與 Web 發布地址。
建立微信小程序原生入口 + WebView 共用計算器的跨平台架構，可配置微信廣告位。
加強敏感資訊忽略規則與 Android 正式簽名流程，避免公開倉庫洩漏密鑰。
新增核心計算、智能精靈及 OCR 回歸測試。
en: Fixed core edge cases in Hong Kong MPF, already-reached savings goals, beginning-of-month deposits, and extreme installment APR calculations.
Fixed Smart Wizard percentage display errors such as showing 3.5% as 0.04%, and corrected its progress indicator.
Fixed severe dark-mode contrast issues by moving home, calculator, wizard, and settings surfaces to Material 3 semantic colors.
Fixed mislabeled Hong Kong P/H mortgage fields, duplicate result labels, and incomplete low-income MPF guidance.
Hardened the cross-platform JSON calculation API so JSON integers, doubles, strings, and boolean representations are normalized safely.
Added a production Web target sharing the same calculation engine and UI as Android.
Added in-app update checks, silent non-blocking startup checks, and a public release manifest for Android and Web destinations.
Added a WeChat Mini Program native shell + WebView architecture with configurable WeChat ad placements.
Hardened secret exclusions and Android release signing so credentials are never published to public repositories.
Added regression coverage for core calculations, Smart Wizard outputs, and policy OCR parsing.
